basePrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Produce ONE original polished ready-to-print children's coloring page for Pinogri Christmas & Winter Animal Friends, ages 3–8. Portrait A4 composition, target2480x3508px highest available resolution. ONLY black smooth bold outlines on pure white, generous CLOSED empty coloring regions, no gray shading, no hatching, no textures, no gradients, no solid dark areas except tiny eyes/noses. Distinct charming storybook animals with large heads and short rounded bodies, friendly clear expressions, mittenlike paws, simple feet, anatomically consistent, exactly two arms and two legs for anthropomorphic mammals and two flippers two feet for penguin. Leave all fur, body and clothing regions WHITE for coloring.  Never include characters not explicitly requested. Large uncluttered forms for crayons, composition for preschool/primary children; no tiny decorative clutter. Pure white safety margin at least8% all edges; composition fills middle80%, no border, no text, no captions, no watermark, no logo, no photograph of paper, no collage. Props must read clearly, no fused paws/objects, no extra limbs. Scene:  Composition must be a SELF-CONTAINED VIGNETTE: every building, branch, furniture piece and prop fully visible with closed outer contours and white margin; nothing cut off by the page edges. Keep scene comfortably inside middle80% of canvas.

characterSpecs.fox: FOX: large triangular ears, soft outlined white muzzle, small oval black eyes and nose, short body, plain scarf, big bushy white-tipped tail.
characterSpecs.rabbit: RABBIT: long upright ears, round small tail, small oval black eyes and nose, simple open vest, soft round muzzle.
characterSpecs.bear: BEAR: round ears, short oval muzzle, small oval black eyes and nose, plain sweater unless apron specified, short round tail.
characterSpecs.deer: DEER: oval longer muzzle, rounded leaf-shaped ears, two small simple antlers, short tiny deer tail NOT a bushy fox tail, neckerchief, cloven hooves; upright anthropomorphic posture except when walking naturally.
characterSpecs.penguin: PENGUIN: round head, pear body, outlined white face and belly patch, oval small beak, two flippers and two feet, bobble hat, ALL body regions WHITE, absolutely NO gray/black body fill.
